SUBJECTS_pit_ladder_hung.lead_html: Pit ladder, redrawn to hang on a wall (PIT_LADDER_REDRAW_HUNG_ON_THE_WALL). Owner 2026-10-16: “It clearly needs to be installed along a side of the pit, like a door to a room, and have a 'slid up' version that's inaccessible to the prisoners below or a 'slid down' version that is clearly visible.” Rotation = the wall it hangs on: north = far wall (visible face), south = near wall (only the hooks show over the lip), east/west = side walls. Stowed is drawn 0.55 cell toward its wall, on the rim. Each column is one candidate; the in-pit mock is Transient/ladder_art_2026-10-16/ladder_in_pit_mock.png.
